findings.text: CrewArgs.view's Literal omits "queue" while reckon/mcp_views.py:4018 adds it to CREW_VIEWS and reckon/mcp_views.py:4894 serves it, so the typed MCP surface does not advertise the view the dispatcher answers. The repository's own guards name the omission: at head a0bf002e72, tests/test_crew_view_serves_every_view.py::test_the_tool_and_the_dispatcher_declare_the_same_views reports "the crew view dispatcher serves these views and the crew tool does not advertise: ['decisions', 'queue']" against ['decisions'] at base 8d870f62598f, and tests/test_skill_contracts.py::test_ship_crew_views_match_the_typed_mcp_surface reports 'queue' as an extra documented view (runs preserved in the review run's logs/parity-tests-head.log and logs/parity-tests-base.log). The 'decisions' and 'review-need' drift pre-dates this node; 'queue' is this change's. The node's goal names the MCP surface, so the third surface is incomplete until the Literal carries the view.

The MCP arm of the parity assertion calls mcp._crew(project=project, view="queue") directly and never goes through CrewArgs, so it exercises the dispatcher rather than the typed surface the repository compares, and the omission at reckon/_mcp_tools.py:92 shipped green behind it. Drive CrewArgs(project=..., view="queue") in _surfaces so the file reddens on that omission.

_wait_reason re-composes the reason an unplaced request is under - "waiting upstream: <refs>" and "blocked upstream: a section this request waits on was closed unfinished (<refs>)" - that reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1998-2003 already composes for the same request's duty row, and the two wordings differ (the obligation appends the redispatch advice). One fact now has two compositions that can drift, where a helper beside section_waits_for would keep one.

"free" is computed as budget - in_use and asserted nowhere: tests/test_the_queue_reads_as_a_queue.py:121 asserts only in_use, and the free figure appears only inside a print at tests/test_the_queue_reads_as_a_queue.py:128, so a regression returning a constant or None still leaves the gate green although the plan makes the points free part of the deliverable document.

The fragment's header names revision e278c21f39 and its command carries -s -rP, while the measure paragraph of docs/evidence/fragments/a-session-spends-a-priority-budget/sspb-the-queue-reads-as-a-queue-from-the-cli-mcp-and.html attributes the same figures to d6b78b4d98; no retained log carries the MEASURE lines (all four scoped-gate logs run -q without -s), so the recorded measures are transcription with no on-disk receipt. Cite one revision and keep the -s run's log.
